title: Mystery schools aim to recover the lost knowledge of the gods on Mars

tellings.quote: one of the primary aspirations of the mystery schools is to recover the lost knowledge of the gods from Mars.

plain: One of the main goals of the mystery schools, secret traditions that pass hidden knowledge to initiates, is "to recover the lost knowledge of the gods from Mars", says the filmmaker Tim Alberino. He tells Michels this as his own reading, drawing on the writer David Flynn and bringing in Elon Musk and Cydonia, a region of Mars where some people see a carved face in photos taken from orbit, and if he is right, the push to reach Mars would carry an old esoteric purpose.
